home.intro: Centralize resident communication, tasks, and finances with a design system tailored for modern share houses.

about.title: A modern control center for intentional communities
about.body: This portal demonstrates a Vue 3 + Vite front-end that aligns with the Share House ecosystem. It ships with routing, global stores, localization, design tokens, and an accessible baseline so teams can move fast without rebuilding foundations.

settings.title: Personalize your experience
settings.description: Choose how the interface looks, feels, and speaks. Preferences are stored locally so every visit starts off on the right foot.
